protocols.title: P21 (10 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No established human dose. Published mouse efficacy studies delivered 60 nmol/g of chow (~94 mcg/mouse/day at reported food intake). Community injectable conventions of 500–1,000 mcg daily are not supported by published human studies. Page gives 10 mg + 2 mL reconstitution only as reference math.

schedule.description: Approximate per-mouse daily amount delivered in feed in published mouse studies; not an injectable or human dose.

regimen.notes: No established human dose. Page states efficacy experiments fed P21 in chow; community injectable amounts lack published basis.
